title: MySQL: Decode caching_sha2_password packets
description:
Decode more of the caching_sha2_password packets

https://dev.mysql.com/doc/dev/mysql-server/latest/page_caching_sha2_authentication_exchanges.html

https://github.com/mysql/mysql-server/blob/1bfe02bdad6604d54913c62614bde57a055c8332/sql-common/client_authentication.cc#L605-L607

Packets with MySQL 8.0.32 on port 8032, use "Decode as...".
[mysql.pcap](/uploads/d00004add5fbf75e75fca2e5959797d9/mysql.pcap)

This has:
- Packet 8: `perform_full_authentication`
- Packet 20: `request_public_key`
- Packet 21: Public key
- Packet 22: Caching_sha2_password response, Payload is encrypted with the public key.
- Packet 44: `fast_auth_success`

The RSA public key isn't decoded. Saving it to a file allows me to do this:
```
$ openssl rsa -in /tmp/pubkey -pubin -noout -text
Public-Key: (2048 bit)
Modulus:
    00:d1:50:02:cb:f6:d8:eb:43:11:b8:f5:ba:68:2c:
    59:6e:2f:a8:d0:48:02:83:1c:c5:39:b6:f2:cc:37:
    e7:4e:75:49:7a:03:97:6e:b7:5c:6e:ed:6a:22:51:
    23:3f:29:fb:50:c0:5f:8d:0a:fe:56:e7:a2:26:f3:
    e3:cf:63:3c:77:fe:86:5f:58:78:7d:8b:b0:5b:86:
    c4:5c:15:68:e0:71:b1:33:c3:74:23:23:b5:05:88:
    da:7c:e6:a8:51:e2:ff:34:8f:9b:2e:27:c7:ef:42:
    a8:ac:87:12:51:1f:a1:f3:bf:43:01:0d:33:94:ac:
    f9:bf:0a:43:60:dd:8b:57:18:9d:8c:5b:f2:e5:b6:
    92:3e:2f:dc:b0:33:2a:8b:68:e2:b4:10:33:6c:d5:
    bd:f7:63:bf:bf:d0:8f:9e:1e:5f:91:d4:4c:6b:69:
    4c:3c:ac:51:68:f7:aa:03:0f:54:ec:20:26:46:a0:
    1a:1d:90:1f:74:8e:64:62:78:f7:be:c3:85:bc:a2:
    f6:76:41:3e:72:46:3c:b2:1e:47:da:eb:68:df:bf:
    a6:83:aa:25:97:93:ec:c9:d3:1b:4a:eb:c5:1c:b7:
    34:25:99:be:fa:87:a6:e7:3d:96:b1:90:5d:c6:6a:
    21:a8:9f:05:a1:ce:37:5b:c2:0e:b7:1b:3e:60:03:
    b0:bf
Exponent: 65537 (0x10001)
```

To test this with MySQL:
1. If SSL/TLS is used it won't use the public key. Use `--ssl-mode=DISABLED`.
2. The public key can be requested from the server with `--get-server-public-key` or be specified with `--server-public-key-path`
3. This needs MySQL 8.0 (server and client)
4. Make sure the user is created with `caching_sha2_password`. This should be the default.
5. To clear the cache and force `perform_full_authentication` again, restart the server.

notes.body: @alagoutte is there a way to do PEM/RSA dissection? Or is there a better way to format the public key?
Do you have look packet-tls(-utils) dissector ? (or SSH ?)

I search for a `gnutls_pubkey_import()` with `GNUTLS_X509_FMT_PEM` but it looks like there isn't anything for that yet. I think I'll leave that for now as there isn't much useful info in the RSA pubkey anyway.
